title: identity.profile.resolved — Payload Schema
description: Response returned by the identity subsystem when a consumer queries a profile by identity_id or by email. An Identity record bridges a Buyer (Commerce) and a Cliente (ERP). Linkage is optional and never forced. A Buyer can exist without a Cliente, and a Cliente can exist without a Buyer. Guest identities are ephemeral and may not produce a persistent Identity record (pending ADR-007).

identity_id.description: Canonical, stable identifier owned by the identity subsystem. Not the same as buyer_id or cliente_id. Never reused after deletion.

email.description: Primary verifiable identifier used to match a Buyer to a Cliente. Null for anonymous or guest identities. Pending ADR-006: whether email is the sole valid linkage key or additional keys (RUT, EIN) are supported.

buyer_id.description: Reference to the Buyer record in commerce.engine. Null if this identity was initiated from the ERP side or if linkage is incomplete.

cliente_id.description: Reference to the Cliente record in erp.core. Null if this identity was initiated from the Commerce side or if linkage is incomplete.

linkage_status.description: unlinked: identity exists in one system only, no verified match across systems. linked: Buyer and Cliente have been explicitly verified as the same person. guest: no persistent identity record; session is ephemeral and will not be linked.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this identity record was created.

linked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when buyer_id and cliente_id were explicitly linked. Null if linkage_status is not 'linked'.
